title: Budkaar
desc: Mini, a young woman, is kidnapped from a pub and police investigate the case. However, when her sister sets out to find her, she uncovers a criminal nexus which shakes the city.

title: Mohabbat Ki Arzoo
desc: A motor mechanic posing as a rich man falls in love with a girl from a wealthy family pretending to be poor. The lovers rebel against their family members and society to remain together.

title: Andaz
desc: Sheetal, a widow, is a school teacher and lives with her son after her husband's death. She meets her student's father Ravi, a widower, and decides to marry him.

title: Dushman Duniya Ka
desc: Mahesh is a honest and diligent young man, who has no knowledge of his background as he was raised in an orphanage. One day he meets Reshma, who is also an orphan, and both fall in love and get married. They live a harmonious life, and soon are proud parents of a healthy young boy who they name Lucky, who ends up causing them alot of trouble.

title: Bhala Manus
desc: Shankar a simple villager comes to Bombay in such of work to improve his financial condition but circumstances force him to take up smuggling.
